modelContract.prepare: Public, one gesture; resets the listed context, clock, actors and pending effects.
modelContract.command: One intervention per episode; its unknown bounded-latency effect has a selected or fixed receiver.
modelContract.background: Context-specific constant remote drift per tick; measured by time-matched WAIT controls.
modelContract.scope: Only the listed, measured public contexts; no claim of universal guard discovery.
modelContract.resource: A command spends its nonnegative cost when affordable; otherwise it has no causal effect.
modelContract.observation: Complete, noiseless public positions, selection, context, reserve and remote counter after each gesture.
excluded: hidden persistent state between prepared episodes
